prompts.title: Tell me about yourself
prompts.promptText: Tell me about yourself and your experience as a software developer.
prompts.hintEs: 2-3 minutos: presente, pasado reciente, hacia donde vas.

prompts.title: Background resumido
prompts.promptText: Walk me through your resume. Focus on the most relevant roles for this position.
prompts.hintEs: No leas el CV; conta la historia.

prompts.title: Transicion de carrera
prompts.promptText: Why did you transition into software development or your current specialty?

prompts.title: Proyecto favorito
prompts.promptText: What project are you most proud of and why?

prompts.title: Ultimo rol
prompts.promptText: Describe your responsibilities in your most recent job.
prompts.hintEs: Enfocate en lo relevante para la vacante.

prompts.title: Aprendizaje reciente
prompts.promptText: What have you learned in the last six months that improved your work?

prompts.title: Trabajo en equipo
prompts.promptText: How would your teammates describe you?

prompts.title: Por que IT
prompts.promptText: Why do you enjoy working in tech?

prompts.title: Idioma y comunicacion
prompts.promptText: How comfortable are you communicating in English with international teams?
prompts.hintEs: Honesto; menciona experiencia remota si tenes.

prompts.title: Disponibilidad
prompts.promptText: Are you currently employed, and what is your notice period?

prompts.title: Fortalezas
prompts.promptText: What are your greatest strengths as a developer?

prompts.title: Debilidades
prompts.promptText: What is your biggest weakness, and how are you working on it?

prompts.title: Feedback recibido
prompts.promptText: Tell me about a piece of feedback you received that changed how you work.

prompts.title: Manejo de presion
prompts.promptText: How do you handle tight deadlines or pressure?

prompts.title: Multitasking
prompts.promptText: How do you prioritize when you have multiple urgent tasks?

prompts.title: Mentoria
prompts.promptText: Have you mentored junior developers? What approach do you take?
prompts.hintEs: Si no, como aprendes de seniors.

prompts.title: Errores propios
prompts.promptText: Tell me about a mistake you made at work. What did you learn?

prompts.title: Adaptabilidad
prompts.promptText: Describe a time you had to adapt quickly to a big change at work.

prompts.title: Autonomia vs guia
prompts.promptText: Do you prefer working independently or with close guidance?

prompts.title: Crecimiento profesional
prompts.promptText: Where do you see yourself growing in the next two years?
prompts.hintEs: Alineado al rol, no CEO en 6 meses.

prompts.title: Por que esta empresa
prompts.promptText: Why do you want to work for our company?

prompts.title: Por que este rol
prompts.promptText: Why are you interested in this specific role?

prompts.title: Por que dejar empleo
prompts.promptText: Why are you looking to leave your current job?

prompts.title: Conoces la empresa
prompts.promptText: What do you know about our product or mission?

prompts.title: Cultura
prompts.promptText: What kind of company culture helps you do your best work?

prompts.title: Largo plazo
prompts.promptText: What are your long-term career goals?

prompts.title: Otras ofertas
prompts.promptText: Are you interviewing with other companies?

prompts.title: Que buscas
prompts.promptText: What are you looking for in your next position?

prompts.title: Contribucion
prompts.promptText: What value would you bring to our team in the first 90 days?

prompts.title: Preguntas para HR
prompts.promptText: Do you have any questions for us?

prompts.title: Conflicto en equipo
prompts.promptText: Tell me about a conflict with a coworker and how you resolved it.

prompts.title: Desacuerdo tecnico
prompts.promptText: Describe a technical disagreement. How did you handle it?

prompts.title: Proyecto dificil
prompts.promptText: Tell me about the most challenging project you worked on.
prompts.hintEs: Que lo hizo dificil y como lo resolviste.

prompts.title: Liderazgo informal
prompts.promptText: Give an example of when you took initiative without being asked.

prompts.title: Fallo del equipo
prompts.promptText: Tell me about a time the team missed a deadline. What was your role?

prompts.title: Cliente dificil
prompts.promptText: Describe dealing with a difficult stakeholder or client.

prompts.title: Aprender algo nuevo
prompts.promptText: Tell me about a time you had to learn a new technology quickly.

prompts.title: Feedback duro
prompts.promptText: Describe receiving harsh criticism. How did you respond?

prompts.title: Mejorar proceso
prompts.promptText: Tell me about a process you improved on your team.

prompts.title: Trabajo remoto
prompts.promptText: How do you stay effective when working remotely with a distributed team?

prompts.title: Experiencia remota
prompts.promptText: Do you have experience working remotely with international teams?

prompts.title: Zona horaria
prompts.promptText: How do you handle time zone differences with teammates?

prompts.title: Home office setup
prompts.promptText: What does your home office setup look like for focused work?

prompts.title: Expectativa salarial
prompts.promptText: What are your salary expectations for this role?

prompts.title: Freelance vs full-time
prompts.promptText: Are you open to full-time employment or only contract work?

prompts.title: Fecha de inicio
prompts.promptText: When would you be available to start?

prompts.title: Visa / relocation
prompts.promptText: Do you require visa sponsorship or are you authorized to work remotely for a US/EU company?

prompts.title: Beneficios
prompts.promptText: What benefits or perks matter most to you besides salary?

prompts.title: Por que deberiamos contratarte
prompts.promptText: Why should we hire you over other candidates?

prompts.title: Cierre entrevista
prompts.promptText: Is there anything else you would like us to know about you?
